mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 4.5% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.5% for two months, or Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in new housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a contraction in consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth expectations and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong industrial production growth (INDPRO > 110 index), manufacturing output expansion signals robust economic activity, which boosts corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO exceeds 110, or Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A declining trend in new housing starts (HOUST) reflects weakening residential construction activity, which is a leading indicator of reduced consumer spending and corporate investment, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST declines, or Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the CPI inflation rate above 2.5% signals accelerating price pressures, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates a deteriorating labor market, which reduces household income and consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high industrial production growth (INDPRO > 110) and strong GDP growth (GDPC1 > 3.0% annualized), the economy is in an expansionary phase, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO exceeds 110 and GDPC1 exceeds 3.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.02.
